lines.text: This is the Fe Galang Da Silva Boarding House, in Legazpi City.
Thirty-three units. One landlady.
And it all lived in pieces.
A spreadsheet, on one USB drive.
A paper invoice book.
Repairs, asked for in a chat.
And inquiries that left no record.
Nothing connected.
So we folded it all into one.
Hivelet.
Her ledger, in her own layout, adding itself up.
A payment can't be recorded twice.
Tenants see their rent on their phones, and pay with GCash.
Repairs get tracked, from request to done.
Visitors ask about a vacant room. No account needed.
And it installs like an app.
We moved in nine hundred thirty-seven of her real records.
Security, graded A-plus.
Quality, rated four point five three, out of five.
Hivelet. Her whole boarding house, in one place.
